issues.what: The post-hoc minimum-skip selection variant is described as run, reported and counted in the family multiplicity statistics, but it was never executed: zero ledger rows carry a 'minskip' family or script 'posthoc_minskip.py', no posthoc_minskip.log or posthoc_*_summary.json exists, and every family candidate count equals grid cells + 1 nested row (202 = 201+1, 55 = 54+1, 10 = 9+1). This matters beyond wording: the study itself identified that the pre-registered nested-CV criterion (max train diff s.t. kept floors, no skipped floor) degenerates to skipping 2 of 826 rows on every 5-min table (the two rows have nets -3651.44 and -5826.65), declared the min-skip variant as the remedy, and then reported the remedy as done. So the nested-CV / CPCV / bootstrap / DSR layer never evaluated a non-degenerate searched gate, and the text claims one more trial in the PBO/SPA family than the ledger holds.
